about: Graphviz sources laid out by both libraries and read as drawing marks (editor spec §43, plugin_interface). Each is laid out once, as JSON, and both the core (graphviz-marks.ts, layoutMarks) and the Python library (graphspec/style/marks.py, layout_marks) read that one layout. Both give the same marks, the same parts in the same order, and the same room round the drawing. Shared by packages/core/test/graphviz-marks-parity.test.js and python/graph_spec/tests/test_marks.py.
